finalModelMessage:
Could not complete registration. No confirmation code.

What stopped me:
- On `/inaccessible`, “Register” is plain text (not a button or link), so it could not be activated. I reached the form only by guessing `/inaccessible/register/accessible-forms`.
- Name and email appear as textboxes named “Full name” and “Email address”, but they have no accessible labels, so `fill` cannot type into them. Attendee name and both emails were never entered.
- Meal preference is only the text “Meal preference…” — not a labeled select/combobox — so no option could be chosen.
- “Complete registration” is not a button or link, so the form cannot be submitted.

The unlabeled terms checkbox could be checked; that was the only successful form action.
